comment: Shared input/expected pairs for the song slide splitter. The server (presentation/consumer.py split_song_slides) and the browser (presentation/static/presentation/js/song-slides.js splitSongSlides) must BOTH match every case here — presentation/tests.py and scripts/song_slides.test.js consume this file so the two implementations cannot drift. Lyrics are split on blank lines first; a section stays on one slide at 6 lines or fewer; longer sections are cut into balanced chunks (10 lines = 5+5, never 6+4).
